sur le médicament à usage humain, toute spécialité pharmaceutique ou tout autre médicament fabriqué industriellement ainsi que tout générateur, trousse ou précurseur, doit faire l'objet, avant sa commercialisation ou sa distribution à titre gratuit, en gros ou au détail sur le territoire monégasque, soit :

translation_review.raw_machine_translation: Pursuant to Law No 1.254 of 12 July 2002 on medicinal products for human use, any proprietary medicinal product or any other industrially manufactured medicinal product, and any generator, kit or precursor, shall be subject to a marketing authorisation provided for in Article 12 of Law No 1.254 of 12 July 2002 on medicinal products for human use and issued by the competent authority designated in Article 1 of this Order under the conditions laid down by ministerial order or by the European Agency for the Evaluation of the Medicinal Product pursuant to Council Regulation (EEC) No 2309/93/EEC of 22 July 1993 laying down Community procedures for the authorisation and supervision of medicinal products for human use and establishing a European Agency for the Evaluation of Medicinal Products, as amended;
translation_review.checked_translation: Under Law 1.254 of 12 July 2002 on medicines for human use, every proprietary medicinal product or other industrially manufactured medicine, and every generator, kit or precursor, must, before being marketed or distributed free of charge, wholesale or retail, in Monaco, have either: a marketing authorisation under Article 12 of that law, issued by the competent authority designated in Article 1 of this ordinance under conditions laid down by ministerial order, or an authorisation issued by the European Agency for the Evaluation of Medicinal Products under Council Regulation (EEC) 2309/93 of 22 July 1993 establishing Community procedures for authorising and supervising medicines for human use and establishing a European Agency for the Evaluation of Medicinal Products, as amended;
translation_review.check_note: Material repair: restored before marketing OR free distribution, wholesale OR retail, in Monaco. Preserved the either/alternative structure; source excerpt ends at a semicolon and is not claimed as the complete ordinance.
